question.text: A person is to count 4500 currency notes. Let $a_n$ denote the number of notes he counts in the $\mathrm{n}^{\text {th }}$ minute. If $\mathrm{a}_1=\mathrm{a}_2=\ldots \ldots=\mathrm{a}_{10}=150$ and $\mathrm{a}_{10}, \mathrm{a}_{11}, \ldots \ldots$ are in A.P. with common difference $-2$, then the time taken by him to count all notes is

solution.text:
Till $10^{\text {th }}$ minute number of counted notes $=1500$
$$
3000=\frac{n}{2}[2 \times 148+(n-1)(-2)]=n[148-n+1]
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
& n^2-149 n+3000=0 \\
& n=125,24 \\
& n=125 \text { is not possible. }
\end{aligned}
$$
Total time $=24+10=34$ minutes.
